end

source:

source:

end

end

end

end

source:

source:

name: For statements
source:
for x in xs end

for x in xs foo(x) end

for i in [1, 2, 3]
  println(i)
end

for (a, b) in cs
  println(a, b)
end

name: For outer statements
source:
n = 1
for outer n = range
  body
end

for outer x = iter, outer y = iter
  body
end

name: If statements
source:
if a
elseif b
else
end

if true 1 end
if true 1 else 0 end

if a
  b()
elseif c 
  d()
  d()
else
  e()
end

name: Try statements
source:
try
    result = fallible_func(resource)
catch exception
    log(:err, exception)
else
    log(:ok, result)
finally
    close(resource)
end

try
catch e
 e
end

try catch e e end
try catch e end
try catch end
try finally end

try
catch e_with_a_space_behind_it 
end

try
catch e_with_a_space_behind_it 
  body
end

source:
return
return a
return a || b
return a, b, c

source:

end

source:

    end
end
